Package com.eqixiac.equinix.customerportal.model

package com.eqixiac.equinix.customerportal.model
Customer Portal model interfaces for the Equinix Java SDK. Defines data access contracts for portal resources including TroubleTicket, SmartHandResponse, OrderResponse, Order, Quote, InvoiceDetail, and SupportCase. Order-submission resources (cross-connects, shipments, work visits, secure cabinets) return an OrderResponse; the resulting order is then tracked through Order.
